question: {If } 40\% { of } 20\% { of } (4)/(7) { of a number is 336, find the number.}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert percentages: 40% = 2/5 and 20% = 1/5

So expression becomes (2/5) × (1/5) × (4/7) of number = 336

Multiply fractions: 8/175 of number = 336

Number = 336 × (175/8)

**∴ Answer = 7350**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

40% of 20% of (4/7) of a number = 336

**Formula used:**

Percentage conversion: x% = x/100 and successive multiplication

**Calculation:**

⇒ 40% = 40/100 = 2/5

⇒ 20% = 20/100 = 1/5

⇒ So equation: (2/5) × (1/5) × (4/7) × Number = 336

⇒ (8/175) × Number = 336

⇒ Number = 336 ÷ (8/175)

⇒ Number = 336 × (175/8)

⇒ Number = 42 × 175

⇒ Number = 7350

**∴ The correct answer is 7350.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction

x% = x/100 helps simplify chained percentage problems.

Successive Percentage

Multiple percentages are multiplied sequentially.

Fraction Multiplication

Multiply numerators and denominators directly.

Reverse Calculation

To find original value, divide by the fraction or multiply by its reciprocal.
